intervals.note: Start is the first BOSS dark-time observation season; the spectrographs continue in use in SDSS-V as the primary instruments of the Black Hole Mapper (sdss.org BOSS Spectrographs page).

placements.note: Start left open: the pages give BOSS first observations as fall 2009, but the spectrographs were rebuilt from the original SDSS spectrographs earlier.
placements.quote: In SDSS-V, one of (these two) BOSS spectrographs remained on the Sloan Telescope at Apache Point Observatory (APO) in New Mexico

summary.plain: Two identical fibre-fed spectrographs, rebuilt from the original SDSS ones, that record the colours of up to 1,000 galaxies or quasars at once for BOSS, eBOSS and now SDSS-V.
summary.technical: Two rebuilt SDSS spectrographs (red and blue cameras split near 6000 Å), 1,000 fibres per plug plate for BOSS and eBOSS, resolution about 1560–2650, 3600–10,400 Å; in SDSS-V one remains at Apache Point and one is at Las Campanas.

technology.quote: The two identical BOSS spectrographs were rebuilt from the original SDSS spectrographs.
technology.value: Two identical dual-channel fibre-fed optical spectrographs rebuilt from the original SDSS spectrographs, fed by 1,000 fibres in 3-degree plug plates for BOSS and eBOSS.
